name: 120-currency-unit-from-table
description: JPY is a code of the currency table, so it is a currency unit, also when its prefix ¥ is not a currency sign. A statement of AUD does not allow it, so ¥5,200 goes to review in JPY. Under a statement of JPY the value is admitted (spec 0.11, #368).
